item.title: Community Foundation presents C4 with $10,000 grant
item.description: In celebration of Arkansas Community Foundation’s 50th anniversary, Carroll County Community Foundation has awarded a $10,000 grant to C4 — Training for the Future, an industrial training facility in Berryville for students from Berryville, Green Forest and Eureka Springs high schools.
